key_insight: CFDTwin turns a case-specific POD-NN CFD surrogate workflow into an open-source Python toolkit and GUI for reusable ANSYS Fluent automation, training, and prediction.
engineering_relevance: It helps engineers reduce repeated CFD cost in design optimization, uncertainty analysis, and digital-twin workflows while keeping surrogate models interpretable.
method: Generates design-of-experiments samples and launches/resumes Fluent batch simulations.
Extracts simulation outputs and builds POD-NN surrogate models for scalar, surface-field, and cell-zone quantities.
Provides Python API and GUI tools to validate models and predict new design points without rerunning Fluent.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports prior POD-NN results that predicted 2D thermal fields in an electronics-cooling cold plate with large inference speedups while preserving modal structure.
watch_item: Practical performance will depend on the quality of sampled CFD data, the chosen reduced-order basis, and how well the trained surrogate generalizes beyond the design space.
paper_title: CFDTwin: An open-source GUI and Python toolkit for POD-NN surrogate modeling of ANSYS Fluent simulations
